page.overview:
Who is Azula-Hej?

Azula-Hej was a male Voss from the planet Voss living during the Cold War. He was among the few of his people who left their homeworld to see the larger galaxy. Azula-Hej eventually settled on Alderaan, where around 3640 BBY he was delivered a package from his home by the Voidhound.
